blocks.text: You can connect your Airtable organization to Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) to continuously monitor and correct Software as a Service (SaaS) security posture and ensure regulatory compliance is maintained across the organization.
A user with Airtable Admin privileges is required to connect Advanced SSPM to your Airtable organization.
To connect your Airtable organization to Advanced SSPM:

blocks.item: Click Connect in the upper-right corner of the SaaS Dashboard.
From the drop-down menu, select Airtable.
In the Add Integration window, enter your Airtable Enterprise Account ID, and then click Add.

blocks.text: You can find the Airtable Enterprise Account ID in the left-side navigation of the Airtable admin panel. To learn more about accessing the admin panel, refer to the Airtable documentation.
A consent window appears, where you can see a detailed list of permissions and data.

blocks.item: Click your name under Authorize as at the bottom of the window, and then select your organization name.
Click Grant access, and grant approvals if prompted.

blocks.text: Your Airtable organization is now connected. After integration is completed, a success message appears, and the tenant details are updated on the Settings page.
